consts.baseRuleTheMostExpensive: Base rule. The most expensive equipment gets more. Every asset has a purchase value, so the allocation is never left without a criterion.
consts.basedOnTheTimeEach: Based on the time each machine occupies the department in the month: time per unit × productivity of each setup.
consts.theCompanyEntersThePercentage: The company enters the percentage for each machine. It does not update on its own when the department changes: review it when buying, selling or changing an asset's productivity.
consts.onTheJourneyToExcellence: On the journey to excellence, everything starts with organizing and structuring information. This starting point lays the foundation for the business to move forward in an organized and professional way.
consts.theCompanyMovesPastImprovisation: The company moves past improvisation, making sure no job is forgotten, with organized information and a more professional image.
consts.withTheFoundationLaidIn: With the foundation laid in the Start Step, the next step is to strengthen the business's financial and commercial stability with more robust tools.
consts.thisIsTheBigLeap: This is the big leap! With financial stability in place, it's time to deepen your knowledge of costs and structure your processes for greater efficiency.
consts.theCompanyGainsClarityAbout: The company gains clarity about its operation, narrows its product line to focus on what is most profitable and standardizes processes, reducing the owner's sole dependence.
consts.inThisStepTheCompany: In this step, the company gets an exclusive production board, built for the specific needs of visual communication and print companies.
consts.atTheMostAdvancedPoint: At the most advanced point of the journey, the focus is on integrating all previous steps for complete and efficient stock management.
consts.theCompanyReachesOperationalExcellence: The company reaches operational excellence, with full control over costs, stock and processes, resulting in more efficiency and profitability.
